_comment: #423 THE [Pick Lock] DEBUT CANONICAL, and the two-mode rule's proof. THREE phases off three saves, each swapped in through the real pause-menu Load path. PHASE 0 (near_hedault, no rogue line, no commission): the work-room door refuses through use_skill's SKILL_UNKNOWN + the prop's own locked_toast, and the map never changes. PHASE 1 (enchanter_pick_start, rogue 2): the bare interact HINTS (interact never auto-casts), the field cast opens the lock, the SAME interact then transitions, and the case hands over enchanters_true_gauge exactly once (a second interact answers 'Empty.'). PHASE 2 (enchanter_key_start, the finished commission and NO rogue line at all): [Pick Lock] is not even on the bar, Hedault opens the door himself off his own trust arm, and the room hands over the SAME id -- which is what 'contents identical on both paths' has to mean to be worth anything. Every gate counter is CREATED by the run: no fixture pre-holds enchanter_work_room_opened, and the case banks no counter at all -- container_state is the one-shot (I3 review), and no fixture pre-stages adjacency to anything. Zero combat (asserted).

steps._comment: == PHASE 0: THE REFUSAL == near_hedault is the honest no-skill/no-key save: warrior 10, no rogue line, setting_commissioned unbanked. It boots on the enchanter_shop landing cell (6,7) -- the open cell north of the shop door -- not beside anything.
Walk the shop floor to the work-room door's only approach, (8,4), and bump north into (8,3).
Bare interact with the gate unmet and the Skill unknown: interactions.gd falls through to use_skill, which emits SKILL_UNKNOWN and speaks the prop's own locked_toast. No hint, no bank, no transition.

THE EXPLICIT-SKILL-USE DIRECTIVE (2026-07-10): a KNOWN required Skill hints toward the hotbar. Interact never auto-casts, so this interact still does not open the door.

The rules in there are the rules out here: nothing with a tag on it leaves, because it is not mine to lend. The brass gauge on top of the case carries no tag and no order waits on it. I keep a second.
